ideas.pitch: A real-time sentiment tracker and LLM analytics dashboard that aggregates crowdsourced forecasts from Glimpse across Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and Gold.
ideas.title: GlimpseCrowdSentiment
ideas.why_it_could_win: Glimpse explicitly highlights that their platform creates a novel dataset of what thousands believe will happen next; this tool directly showcases and leverages that exact dataset.

ideas.pitch: A mini copy-trading platform that uses the participant's starting 5,000 sats to mirror the top-performing forecasters on Glimpse automatically.
ideas.title: SatsCopyTrader
ideas.why_it_could_win: Resonates with winning copy-trading platform patterns like ClashX while directly utilizing the 5,000 satoshi staking mechanism provided by Glimpse.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent that monitors a user's active price target forecasts on Glimpse and suggests automated hedging positions on crypto perpetuals.
ideas.title: ForecastHedgeAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge autonomous agent mechanics with real market data and forecasting inputs, appealing to judges looking for functional financial utility.

ideas.pitch: A trading strategy tool that compares Glimpse crowd-predicted price targets against live decentralized exchange funding rates to identify market mispricings.
ideas.title: OracleArbitrageGlimpse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on proven funding-rate arbitrage concepts by layering crowd-sourced predictive data on top of standard quantitative finance signals.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized identity and credential gating tool that proves a user's successful forecast ranking on Glimpse to unlock exclusive alpha channels or perks.
ideas.title: SatoshiPredictionPass
ideas.why_it_could_win: Blends decentralized identity concepts with on-chain reputation systems, providing a creative use case for community gamification around Glimpse leaderboards.
